proposal.quote: Chamberlain’s timely declaration (a) is aimed to serve as an interim commitment somewhat as if Britain had taken out a “binder” on Poland
proposal.rule: claude backend: The Prime Minister's declaration is reported as already made and treated as a British commitment to Poland, which is what the polish_guarantee flag records; the document gives no date for it, so the document date is used.

proposal.quote: means that Britain and France have decided their front lines of defense east of Berlin lie not only at the Dardanelles ... but also definitely in Poland
proposal.rule: claude backend: A standing British (and French) commitment to fight for Poland, a third state Germany threatens, meets the resolved threshold, though this reading rests on an American ambassador's interpretation.

proposal.quote: Prime Minister Chamberlain’s pronouncement of March 30 [31], by which British power was related to the independence of Poland
proposal.rule: claude backend: The polish_guarantee flag is set by the Prime Minister's statement of 31 Mar 1939, which the document reports as tying British power to Polish independence.

proposal.quote: Prime Minister Chamberlain’s pronouncement of March 30 [31], by which British power was related to the independence of Poland
proposal.rule: claude backend: Under the resolved rule, a standing commitment to fight for a third state threatened by Germany (the Polish guarantee) meets the threshold.

proposal.quote: The armed absorption of Bohemia and Moravia
proposal.rule: claude backend: Under the german rule, the document reports Bohemia and Moravia as already absorbed by German arms in the latter half of March.

proposal.quote: so long as the “axis” holds
proposal.rule: claude backend: The document treats the Rome-Berlin alignment as existing and holding, which meets the rule for axis true.

proposal.quote: Germany, which has readmitted Austria into the fold
proposal.rule: claude backend: Under the annexed rule, the document reports Austria as already incorporated into the Reich.

proposal.quote: they have come to a reciprocal agreement: England fights for Poland and Poland fights for England
proposal.rule: claude backend: resolved requires a standing commitment to fight for a third state that Germany threatens, and the passage reports an agreed British commitment to fight for Poland.

proposal.quote: he is more than happy to have England's support given in the way that it was, i. e., that Poland is the one to determine when England is to come to her rescue
proposal.rule: claude backend: The flag is true once the British guarantee to Poland has been given, and the passage refers to British support already given that obliges Britain to come to Poland's rescue.

proposal.quote: Hitler will be roaring mad at Poland’s action in tying up with Great Britain
proposal.rule: claude backend: The passage reports Poland's tie-up with Britain, read with Chamberlain's speech on the Polish situation, as already made, consistent with the British guarantee to Poland being in place.

proposal.quote: Chamberlain’s speech on the Polish situation ... Poland’s action in tying up with Great Britain
proposal.rule: claude backend: A standing British tie-up with Poland, a third state threatened by Germany, meets the resolved threshold of a standing commitment to fight for a third state.

proposal.quote: Great Britain was pledged to go to the support not only of France but also of Switzerland, Belgium and the Netherlands in case of a German or other attack on those powers

proposal.quote: those in Czechoslovakia some months ago which I need not elaborate upon, since it was a question of forceful taking by German authorities
proposal.rule: claude backend: Bohemia is german once Germany has taken the Czech lands, and the Secretary of State refers to the 'forceful taking by German authorities' of Czechoslovakia as an accomplished fact some months before this document; the passage does not name the Protectorate, so the threshold reading is a judgment.

proposal.quote: they can get no assurances from him, however, that he wants to do anything with England ... If he has made up his mind to take England on, no olive branch will have any effect on him and there is a very definite feeling now that that is what he has in the back of his head.
proposal.rule: claude backend: belief_WEST hegemonic: the Foreign Secretary says no assurances can be had from Hitler and that he probably means to take on England, which treats German aims as beyond negotiated revision; this is one minister reported second-hand, not the PM and Cabinet, and he still allows that Danzig could be settled.

proposal.quote: if Poland should declare war on Germany under such circumstances France or England could or would stand aside. Both France and England certainly would march.
proposal.rule: claude backend: Resolved means a standing commitment to fight for a third state that Germany threatens; the French Foreign Minister states that France and Britain would certainly fight for Poland.

proposal.quote: He could see no way out for Hitler but war.
proposal.rule: claude backend: Hegemonic means the governments treat Germany as seeking its ends by force; the French Foreign Minister expects Hitler to choose war, though this is one Paris minister rather than the British Cabinet.

proposal.quote: After the signature of the Italian alliance with Germany
proposal.rule: claude backend: The Rome-Berlin alignment holds; the document refers to an Italian-German alliance already signed, which presupposes the alignment.

proposal.quote: In case Poland and Germany should become involved in war it was absolutely certain that France would declare war on Germany.
proposal.rule: claude backend: Resolved requires a standing commitment to fight for a third state that Germany threatens; the French Premier states France will certainly declare war if Germany and Poland go to war.

proposal.quote: he personally was convinced that Hitler intended to make war this summer, would begin war by an attack on Danzig
proposal.rule: claude backend: Hegemonic means the head of government treats Germany as seeking its ends by force; the French Premier says he is convinced Hitler intends war this summer, though he says nothing of world domination.

proposal.quote: if the Neutrality Act in the United States should be altered to permit shipments of arms, munitions and implements of war
proposal.rule: claude backend: Isolationist means the Neutrality Act's mandatory arms embargo is in force; the passage treats the Act as not yet altered to permit arms shipments.

proposal.quote: feared that the negotiations might be dragged out indefinitely
proposal.rule: claude backend: The flag stays false while no Anglo-Soviet alliance is concluded; the passage shows the political negotiations still unfinished, with no military agreement.

proposal.quote: the delays already encountered or for a possible failure to reach any agreement
proposal.rule: claude backend: The alliance flag is true only once an Anglo-Soviet alliance is concluded; the passage shows that the Anglo-French-Soviet negotiations are still unconcluded and may fail, so the flag stays false.

proposal.quote: while neutrality legislation was under consideration in Congress the project might well be subjected to misrepresentation and thus cause the Administration difficulty in its endeavor to have the Neutrality Act amended
proposal.rule: claude backend: The existing Neutrality Act regime is still in force, with amendment only being sought in Congress, so the arms embargo has not been repealed and the level stays isolationist.

proposal.quote: he still believed there were eighty chances in a hundred that the negotiations between the Soviet Union and France and England would be concluded successfully in the near future
proposal.rule: claude backend: The alliance is true only if concluded; the passage shows the Anglo-French-Soviet negotiations still unconcluded on the document's date.

proposal.quote: the House of Representatives was about to pass the Bloom proposals for alterations in the Neutrality Act
proposal.rule: claude backend: Isolationist holds while the Neutrality Act regime stands; the passage reports amendments only pending in the House, so the Act is not yet changed or repealed.
